question: Does the unchanged coherent-cycle component carrier commit the pre-download-frozen new-family PV28 partial-view positive and reject both fixed cross-scene exact-target-absent controls?

predecessor.single_change: Use the pre-download-frozen PV28 reference/query views admitted by the fixed anti-sliver maximum-depth-visible partial-view source gate. Keep every carrier model, mask, cycle, affine extent and decision gate unchanged.

reference_binding.support_surface: One native SAM2 mask from the frozen partial reference bbox.
reference_binding.extent_surface: Frozen partial reference bbox transported independently to each query.
reference_binding.query_truth_isolation: Positive query bbox opens only after transport; negatives receive no exact-target query truth.

proposal.transport: Unchanged full-frame symmetric RoMa, bilateral 0.05 certainty, in-bounds target, 0.013888888888888888 round-trip error, largest 8-connected reference cycle component, ordinary affine fit and bound-extent transport.
proposal.component_tie_break: Maximum area then lowest label; no fallback.
proposal.mask: One native reference and query SAM2 identity-support mask; no selection, morphology or retry.
proposal.query_extent: Transported bbox; query SAM mask is support only.

matcher.absolute_support: Frozen cycle opportunity plus dominant-component majority; global purity remains diagnostic only.

evaluation.negative_authority: Different physical 3RScan reference families cannot contain exact target PV28.

forbidden_after_freeze: change models, pair, frame, mask, cycle, component, affine fit or gates
use query truth or negative results to repair the carrier
retry, replace or remove a failed pair
generalize beyond this narrow same-provider new-family confirmation
claim_boundary: This is one pre-download-frozen new physical target and scan family under an unchanged carrier, with two fixed cross-scene target-absent controls. A gate pass is narrow same-provider partial-view carrier confirmation, not arbitrary sibling rejection, provider independence, raw-camera binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, deployment, benefit, reliability or safety.
